FAQ

Questions business owners ask me

Something else on your mind? Send me an email, I usually reply the same day.

Email me
How much does a website cost?

It depends on the number of pages and features. Tell me what you need and I'll send a fixed quote within a day or two, so you know the full price before we start.

How long does it take?

A typical small-business website takes two to four weeks, depending on how quickly the content and feedback come in.

What do I need to give you?

Your logo, rough notes about your services, and photos if you have them. I can help write the text. If you already have a domain or hosting, share the login and I'll handle the rest.

Can I update the website myself?

Yes. I can add a simple editor for your blog or news, and small text changes are included in the care plan.

Do I own the website and domain?

Yes. The domain, hosting and code are in your name. I set things up so you're never locked in to me.

Let's build your website

Tell me about your business. I'll reply with a clear plan and a fixed quote.
